steps.content: But after a day of fighting, prolonged Mania contact finally affects her consciousness briefly deep in the night.
Once again, she starts dreaming of the past.

steps.speaker: Calm Voice
steps.content: She's the only one who came back from DisSea? The lone survivor... How impressive.
...Commander from...Paradeisos...?
The mission... failed... The defense line... and the people in the city... what happened to them...

steps.speaker: Calm Voice
steps.content: It didn't fail. The city-state is safe, do not worry.

steps.speaker: Calm Voice
steps.content: How much do you remember about the front line? Do you remember how you left?
I remember... I remember... There are people who didn't leave... Many stayed behind...
...Please, go save them... I beg of you... don't leave her there...

steps.speaker: Calm Voice
steps.content: It's too late. DisSea's tide has risen, and the combat zone is now completely submerged. If anyone goes there now, no amount of protective gear will help them survive for more than three hours.
...Completely submerged...?

steps.speaker: Calm Voice
steps.content: Don't worry. Paradeisos won't forget you. All the soldiers will receive medals of honor.
Her breathing quickens.
You knew this would happen... You knew the tide would rise in DisSea... You knew it would submerge the area...
You knew all along it would end like this...
Then why did you send us there?!!!
She lunges at the blurred-faced Paradeisos representative, roaring in fury. Several hands reach out to stop her as she lashes out.
There wasn't enough time to begin with! It was a suicide mission! You knew that all along! Why didn't you warn us?! Why did you cover this up?! Do all those lives mean nothing to you?!
The FAC trusted your calculations and arrangements, and carried out your orders without any doubt. They just wanted to fight for the city-state, and this is what they get in return?! To die in vain?!
What kind of a joke is this?!! Why was such a mission arranged?!
<size=40><color=#fb9259>Who</color> issued the order?!!</size>

steps.speaker: Calm Voice
steps.content: ...There's no cover-up, nor the need to explain anything. Discussion will only sow confusion. That's not what the FAC needs.

steps.speaker: Calm Voice
steps.content: You've all fulfilled your life's worth. People will naturally honor you for that.
...I'll kill you!!!!
The last bit of her sanity snaps. She lunges forward, but gets hammered to the ground, surrounded and hauled away.

steps.speaker: Calm Voice
steps.content: ...Don't worry. It's just mental trauma from the battlefield. It's a common occurrence in the FAC. Take her to recovery, poor her.

steps.speaker: Calm Voice
steps.content: Even a dog would become mentally unstable from losing its owner.
Stop, don't leave...!! Who assigned that mission? Who is 05257885? Tell me!
<color=#fb9259>Who</color> from Paradeisos sent us to die?!
Rahu wakes up to her phone vibrating in her hand, but she doesn't answer it. The vibration eventually stops, leaving behind the words FAC Encrypted Call in the missed call section.
She rises and puts her mask back on, attempting to cover her heavy panting.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: ...<color=#fb9259>An abandoned dog</color>, how fitting...

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: I can smell the scent... It won't take long now... Just you wait...

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: I'm coming to sink my fangs into your necks.
